signals.title: Federal Right to Repair
signals.subtitle: REPAIR Act — H.R. 906
signals.headline: In House Energy & Commerce Committee
signals.detail: H.R. 906 — 4 cosponsors. Status: Introduced. Manufacturer lobbying remains the primary obstacle.

signals.title: Federal Helmet Pressure
signals.subtitle: NHTSA Rulemaking Watch
signals.headline: NHTSA reviewing helmet standards
signals.detail: NHTSA proposing updated FMVSS No. 218 standards. No federal mandate proposed — monitoring for rider impact.

signals.title: AMA Legislative Session
signals.subtitle: 2026 Priorities
signals.headline: AMA tracking 34 state bills in 2026
signals.detail: American Motorcyclist Association monitoring lane filtering, right to repair, and profiling legislation across 34 states.

signals.title: Lane Filtering Bills
signals.subtitle: State Legislation
signals.headline: Active in 9 states this session
signals.detail: Bills advancing in TX, OH, GA, TN, NC, VA, MI, PA, FL. Utah and Montana already permit filtering.

signals.title: Stop Motorcycle Profiling Act
signals.subtitle: Federal — S.1424 / H.R.2843
signals.headline: Reintroduced in 119th Congress
signals.detail: Federal bill would direct DOJ to issue guidance ending discriminatory traffic stops based on motorcycle affiliation.

signals.title: State Helmet Law Landscape
signals.subtitle: 50-State Coverage
signals.headline: 3 states have no helmet law
signals.detail: IL, IA, NH have no helmet requirement. 19 states + DC mandate universal coverage. 28 states have age-based partial laws.

items.update: Gained 12 new cosponsors — now at 67 total. Manufacturer lobby spending up $2.1M this quarter.
Passed House Transportation Committee 8–3. Heading to full House vote.
